rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: SPA, Riyadh 17 Muharram 1423 / 31 March 2002: the Council's 65th ordinary session, held that day, was chaired by 'معالى رئيس المجلس الدكتور صالح بن عبدالله بن حميد'; on 16 Muharram 1423 / 30 March 2002 Jamil al-Hujailan had congratulated him on the royal trust in appointing him Chairman.
rows.locator: Datelines الرياض 17 محرم 1423ه الموافق 31 مارس 2002 and الرياض 16 محرم 1423ه الموافق 30 مارس 2002

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair).
